stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.13 beta improves employer detection after the real v2.9.12 macOS run: 173 vacancies discovered, 13 REVIEW, 0 automated APPLY; the improved REVIEW shortlist supported 2/2 successful human-confirmed Jobs.cz submissions (BI Specialista – SQL a reporting at cbData s.r.o., score 74; Specialista/ka datové kvality score 70). The latter vacancy (Jobs.cz 2001283488) did not identify its employer in Job Agent; public Jobs.cz listings display Skupina ČEZ for this title. The app now recovers employer names from employer logos only when a company/logo marker or a matching nearby label confirms the context, supports image-only company blocks in detail HTML and employer microsites, and ignores decorative images, generic logo labels, location names and job titles. No company is hard-coded. 73/73 offline regressions passed in GitHub Actions; no change to scoring or final manual Submit safety.
